title: Efficient Correlation Computation for Higher-Degree Boolean Functions
summary: Exact correlation is efficiently computable for quadratic Boolean functions; whether an efficient method exists for degree greater than two remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether there is an efficient algorithm for computing the correlation of Boolean functions of degree greater than two.

scope.domain: Boolean-function correlation and algorithmic questions in symmetric cryptanalysis.
parameters: Boolean-function degree, with the unresolved case being greater than two
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether there is an efficient algorithm for computing the correlation of Boolean functions of degree greater than two.

citations.label: Correlation of Quadratic Boolean Functions: Cryptanalysis of All Versions of Full $$\mathsf {MORUS}$$

progress.summary: The authors present this as the first of two open questions after giving a polynomial-time method for exact correlation of arbitrary quadratic Boolean functions. They note that an efficient higher-degree algorithm would significantly affect cryptanalysis.
citation_labels: Danping Shi et al., Correlation of Quadratic Boolean Functions: Cryptanalysis of All Versions of Full $$\mathsf {MORUS}$$
